title: Peanut Butter Pumpkin Fudge
description: No-bake freezer fudge: peanut butter, pumpkin, coconut oil and maple syrup with a little pumpkin pie spice, finished with flaky sea salt.

steps.heading: Mix
steps.text: Mix all the ingredients except the flaky salt until well combined.

steps.heading: Pan
steps.text: Pour into a parchment-lined 8x8 pan and spread evenly. Sprinkle the top with flaky sea salt.

steps.heading: Freeze
steps.text: Cover and freeze for 2 hours, then lift out of the pan and cut into squares.

notes: Keep it chilled — the coconut oil softens at room temperature.
